a: Thank you in French is Merci; more polite Merci beaucoup.
Thank you in Spanish is Gracias.
Thank you in Arabic is Shukran (شكراً).
Thank you in Mandarin is 谢谢 (Xièxie).
Thank you in Hindi is धन्यवाद (Dhanyavaad).
Thank you in Portuguese is Obrigado (m) / Obrigada (f).
Thank you in German is Danke.
Thank you in Japanese is ありがとう (Arigatou) / ありがとうございます.
Thank you in Korean is 감사합니다 (Gamsahamnida).
Thank you in Swahili is Asante / Asante sana.
